smooth OFX plugin — Release Notes
=================================

Version      : 1.4.0
Release date : 2026-04-20
Platforms    : macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon), macOS x86_64 (Intel), Windows x64
Signed       : Ad hoc on macOS, NOT notarized (test distribution build)

Initial OpenFX port of the "smooth" plugin, originally released by LOILO Inc.
as an After Effects plugin. Verified on DaVinci Resolve on both Windows and
macOS.


Release artifacts (macOS)
-------------------------

Per-architecture builds are shipped separately; pick the one that matches
the Mac you install on:

  * smooth-1.4.0-macos-arm64.zip    — Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 …)
  * smooth-1.4.0-macos-x86_64.zip   — Intel Macs

Each archive contains smooth.ofx.bundle (single-arch), README.txt, and
RELEASE-NOTES.txt.

SHA-256 digests are provided alongside each zip as .zip.sha256 files.


Install (macOS)
---------------

See the README.txt bundled inside the archive for step-by-step instructions.

Summary:
  1. Unzip, copy smooth.ofx.bundle to /Library/OFX/Plugins/
  2. sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Library/OFX/Plugins/smooth.ofx.bundle
  3. Restart DaVinci Resolve -> Effects -> Filters -> Smooth


What's new in 1.4.0
-------------------

Added
  * OpenFX 1.5.1 plugin implementation (jp.loilo.smooth, version 1.4).
  * Pixel-depth support: 8-bit integer, 16-bit integer, 16-bit float,
    and 32-bit float RGBA working color spaces.
  * Premultiplied-alpha handling: input is unpremultiplied before the
    smoothing pass and re-premultiplied on output, so Resolve / Fusion
    produce correct edges.
  * Parameters: range (0..100, default 1.0), lineWeight (0..1, default 0.0),
    whiteOption / transparent (boolean).
  * macOS arm64 and x86_64 per-architecture builds, deployment target 11.0,
    proper smooth.ofx.bundle with generated Info.plist.
  * Windows x64 build via MSVC 2019+ or MSYS2 MinGW-w64.
  * Minimal OFX host harness (tests/host_smoke.cpp) for smoke testing
    without a full host.

Fixed
  * Black-pixel artifact on lines in 16/32-bit float color spaces.
    Root cause: int accumulator truncating float pixel values.
  * White-fringe artifact on transparent edges under DaVinci Resolve
    when the transparent option was on. Root cause: algorithm assumed
    straight RGBA; now unpremult/premult are handled.


Known limitations
-----------------

  * Tile rendering is not supported.
  * Multi-resolution / proxy rendering is not verified.
  * GPU render path is not implemented (CPU only).
  * macOS release zips are ad hoc signed but NOT notarized. Gatekeeper
    may still block first load. Remove the quarantine attribute before
    loading:
      sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine \
        /Library/OFX/Plugins/smooth.ofx.bundle


Checksums
---------

  * dist/smooth-1.4.0-macos-arm64.zip.sha256
  * dist/smooth-1.4.0-macos-x86_64.zip.sha256
